description: Piste ciclabili: Piste ciclabili d'interesse regionale e valenza comunale is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappe.partout.it. Cycle paths of regional interest and municipal value. The tracks of regional interest are classified as "high valley route" and "low valley route", the route contains information on bridges, underpasses, connections and stretches of track not accessible, under construction and under design. The cycle paths of municipal value contain information on bridges, underpasses and connections. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Cycle paths: Cycle paths of regional interest and municipal value" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
